card2.descricao: Software development for companies through university extension projects and personal projects using tools like:

barbabrutal.title: Barbabrutal
barbabrutal.subtitle: Barbershop appointments made easy.
barbabrutal.description: A system for scheduling barbershop services, with features like professional registration, scheduling selection, and online payment.

gamerstore.title: GamerStore
gamerstore.subtitle: Online store for gamer products.
gamerstore.description: An online store for gamers, integrating listing and purchasing of popular products.

weather.title: Weather Project
weather.subtitle: Current weather conditions in any city worldwide.
weather.description: This project consumes the Open Weather API to display current weather conditions. The site automatically changes to Snow Mode, Cloud Mode, or Summer Mode based on the searched city's temperature.

movies.title: Movie Finder
movies.subtitle: Discover movies in theaters and save your favorites.
movies.description: This project uses TheMovieDB API to list trending movies and allows users to search the catalog. Features include saving to favorites and watching trailers on YouTube.
